token_savings.optimization: /startup reads .context/current.md instead of HANDOFF.md + PROJECT_STATE.md in full
Current-state lookups read .engineering/context.json instead of parsing PROJECT_STATE.md + HANDOFF.md + NEXT_TASK.md
token_savings.note: context.json stays small by referencing repository.json/executives.json/workflows.json/commands.json instead of inlining their data; those are only read when a task actually needs that detail.

notes: Estimates use a 4-characters-per-token heuristic, not an actual tokenizer count.

Savings apply to routine current-state lookups (sprint/task/decisions/next action). Tasks needing full acceptance criteria, full known-issues detail, or full architecture rationale still read the relevant source file(s) directly.
